deduplication: Normalized FEN first four fields. Identical suite copies count once.

canonical.IDs: WAC.001 through WAC.300, complete and unique

legal_validation.method: chess.Board.from_epd; board.is_valid(); every bm/am Move belongs to board.legal_moves

observed_inventory.workspace_inventory_command: rg --files /workspace, then filename filters for WAC, STS, strategic, .epd and .sts
observed_inventory.workspace_scope_limit: Visible, nonignored paths returned by rg --files; not an assertion about absent hidden/ignored files or remote machines.
observed_inventory.classification: Only the four byte-identical WAC EPD copies qualify. Other candidates are opening books and selected match openings.
observed_inventory.ZIP_method: zipfile.ZipFile.infolist with WAC/STS/strategic/EPD member-name filters; no disk extraction
observed_inventory.full_handoff_EPDS: Three copies of tools/openings/forge-10000.epd; no WAC or STS EPD member

excluded_opening_book.reason: Opening book with Forge-* IDs; not genuine WAC/STS benchmark coverage. Match-selected opening boards and training/parity boards also excluded.

AGENTS_audit.method: Checked AGENTS.md at every absolute ancestor and recursively within the source tree.

actions: File listing, source/text reads, SHA256, archive member inspection and existing-library EPD legality validation only. No engines, compilers, native profiling, network, Git mutations or corpus padding.
acceptance: The full 2000-position S08 experiment remains unverified. An explicit incomplete WAC300 screen cannot satisfy it.
